C2-1-0.name: Choose the aspect
C2-1-0.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo que la primera (transformación tipo CPE).
items: I started learning Portuguese three years ago and I'm still at it. (BEEN) → I ______ three years.
This is my first visit to my grandparents' village. (NEVER) → I ______ before.
Her eyes were red because she had spent hours in tears. (CRYING) → Her eyes were red because she ______ hours.
My brother constantly borrows my clothes without asking, which drives me mad. (FOREVER) → My brother ______ without asking.
I've intended to ring you for weeks but haven't got round to it. (MEANING) → I ______ for weeks.
Next month marks twenty years of my parents' life in Cali. (HAVE) → By next month, my parents ______ for twenty years.
answers: I have been learning Portuguese for three years.
I have never visited my grandparents' village before.
Her eyes were red because she had been crying for hours.
My brother is forever borrowing my clothes without asking.
I've been meaning to ring you for weeks.
By next month, my parents will have been living in Cali for twenty years.

C2-1-1.name: Soften it
C2-1-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con un tiempo pasado que la haga más cortés o distante, usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: Can you lend me your notes? (WONDERING) → I ______ me your notes.
Do you need anything else, madam? (DID) → ______ anything else, madam?
I expected the decision to be reversed, but it wasn't. (HOPED) → I ______ reversed.
Would you consider joining the board? (THOUGHT) → I ______ joining the board.
Please give us an extension. (HOPING) → We ______ an extension.
I want to talk to you about my salary. (WANTED) → I ______ about my salary.
answers: I was wondering if you could lend me your notes.
Did you need anything else, madam?
I had hoped the decision would be reversed.
I thought you might consider joining the board.
We were hoping you might give us an extension.
I wanted to talk to you about my salary.

C2-1-2.name: State or action?
C2-1-2.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con la palabra en mayúsculas en forma continua, conservando el significado.
items: My cousin is currently in a relationship with a musician. (SEEING) → My cousin ______ a musician.
He's normally easy-going, but today he's acting stubbornly. (BEING) → He ______ today.
I'm considering applying for dual nationality. (THINKING) → I ______ dual nationality.
They are going through a difficult period at the moment. (HAVING) → They ______ at the moment.
My sister's baby is due in March. (EXPECTING) → My sister ______ in March.
People keep telling me good things about your new restaurant. (HEARING) → I ______ about your new restaurant.
answers: My cousin is seeing a musician.
He's being stubborn today.
I'm thinking of applying for dual nationality.
They're having a difficult time at the moment.
My sister is expecting a baby in March.
I'm hearing good things about your new restaurant.

C2-2-0.name: Shift the focus
C2-2-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase como oración escindida (cleft) usando la palabra en mayúsculas, sin cambiarla (estilo CPE).
items: Her tone, not her words, offended me. (IT) → It ______ offended me.
I only wanted a straight answer. (ALL) → All ______ a straight answer.
The speaker skilfully exploited the audience's fears. (DID) → What ______ the audience's fears.
I only realised it was propaganda when I checked the sources. (UNTIL) → It ______ that I realised it was propaganda.
His inability to listen really irritates me. (WHAT) → ______ his inability to listen.
The campaign failed because it relied on slogans. (REASON) → The ______ relied on slogans.
answers: It was her tone, not her words, that offended me.
All I wanted was a straight answer.
What the speaker did was skilfully exploit the audience's fears.
It wasn't until I checked the sources that I realised it was propaganda.
What really irritates me is his inability to listen.
The reason (why) the campaign failed was that it relied on slogans.

C2-2-1.name: Front it
C2-2-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase empezando con las palabras dadas, adelantando el elemento e invirtiendo cuando corresponda.
items: The rhetoric was so inflammatory that the broadcast was cut. → So ______
The public reaction was so strong that the slogan was dropped. → Such ______
The minister's refusal to comment was even more revealing. → Even more revealing ______
However hard I tried, I couldn't follow his logic. → Try ______
The era of long, reasoned speeches has passed. → Gone ______
It may sound odd, but I find his bluntness refreshing. → Odd ______
answers: So inflammatory was the rhetoric that the broadcast was cut.
Such was the public reaction that the slogan was dropped.
Even more revealing was the minister's refusal to comment.
Try as I might, I couldn't follow his logic.
Gone are the days of long, reasoned speeches.
Odd as it may sound, I find his bluntness refreshing.

C2-2-2.name: Turn it around
C2-2-2.prompt: Reescribe cada frase empezando con las palabras dadas (transformación tipo CPE).
items: The government didn't admit the error until the inquiry. → Not until ______
They had no idea the microphone was still on. → Little ______
As soon as the article was published, the threats started. → No sooner ______
You must not reveal your sources in any circumstances. → Under no circumstances ______
She not only misquoted him but also distorted his argument. → Not only ______
We only grasped the scale of the deception after reading the leaked emails. → Only after ______
answers: Not until the inquiry did the government admit the error.
Little did they know (that) the microphone was still on.
No sooner had the article been published than the threats started.
Under no circumstances must you reveal your sources.
Not only did she misquote him, but she also distorted his argument.
Only after reading the leaked emails did we grasp the scale of the deception.

C2-3-0.name: Speculate precisely
C2-3-0.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: I'm sure she was exaggerating about the snake. (MUST) → She ______ about the snake.
It's impossible that he remembers his second birthday. (CAN'T) → He ______ his second birthday.
It's quite likely that the witness confused the two men. (WELL) → The witness ______ the two men.
Perhaps they're not answering because they're asleep. (MIGHT) → They're not answering; they ______.
The parcel will almost certainly arrive tomorrow. (BOUND) → The parcel ______ tomorrow.
There's a slim chance that the old photos are still in the loft. (JUST) → The old photos ______ in the loft.
answers: She must have been exaggerating about the snake.
He can't remember his second birthday.
The witness may well have confused the two men.
They're not answering; they might be asleep.
The parcel is bound to arrive tomorrow.
The old photos might just still be in the loft.

C2-3-1.name: Judging the past
C2-3-1.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: It wasn't necessary for you to bring a gift, but thank you. (NEEDN'T) → You ______ a gift, but thank you.
We didn't have to show our passports, so we walked straight through. (NEED) → We ______ our passports, so we walked straight through.
It was a mistake not to back up the files. (SHOULD) → I ______ the files.
It's annoying that you didn't tell me the meeting was cancelled. (MIGHT) → You ______ the meeting was cancelled!
Taking a taxi was an option, but we chose to walk. (COULD) → We ______, but we chose to walk.
I regret saying that to her. (OUGHT) → I ______ that to her.
answers: You needn't have brought a gift, but thank you.
We didn't need to show our passports, so we walked straight through.
I should have backed up the files.
You might have told me the meeting was cancelled!
We could have taken a taxi, but we chose to walk.
I ought not to have said that to her.

C2-3-2.name: Assume and characterise
C2-3-2.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con will, won't o would para expresar suposición o comportamiento típico, usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: I'm sure that's Javier at the door; he's always early. (BE) → That ______ at the door.
I assume you've heard about the merger. (WILL) → You ______ about the merger.
When we were children, our aunt used to tell us ghost stories. (WOULD) → When we were children, our aunt ______.
It's so annoying that he keeps checking his phone at dinner. (WILL) → He ______ at dinner!
Of course she defended him; that's typical of her. (WOULD) → She ______, wouldn't she?
The machine refuses to start in cold weather. (WON'T) → The machine ______ in cold weather.
answers: That'll be Javier at the door.
You will have heard about the merger.
When we were children, our aunt would tell us ghost stories.
He will keep checking his phone at dinner!
She would defend him, wouldn't she?
The machine won't start in cold weather.

C2-4-0.name: Make it noun-heavy
C2-4-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase en estilo de informe, convirtiendo el verbo o adjetivo principal en sustantivo. Empieza como se indica.
items: Sales increased sharply in the third quarter. → There was ______
The board decided to merge the two departments, which surprised everyone. → The board's ______
The project failed because it was badly managed. → The project's ______
Employees are reluctant to adopt the new software. → There is ______
If we reduce costs, we'll be able to invest more. → A reduction ______
More and more customers want sustainable products. → There is ______
answers: There was a sharp increase in sales in the third quarter.
The board's decision to merge the two departments surprised everyone.
The project's failure was due to poor management.
There is reluctance among employees to adopt the new software.
A reduction in costs will enable greater investment.
There is growing demand for sustainable products.

C2-4-1.name: Trim the clause
C2-4-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con una cláusula de participio o una relativa reducida, empezando como se indica.
items: The employees who were made redundant received a generous package. → The employees ______
Because she had worked there for a decade, she knew everyone. → Having ______
Anyone who wishes to apply should submit a CV by Friday. → Anyone ______
He was the only candidate who passed all three interviews. → He was the only candidate ______
As they were confronted with falling sales, the directors changed strategy. → Confronted ______
Because I didn't know the dress code, I turned up in jeans. → Not ______
answers: The employees made redundant received a generous package.
Having worked there for a decade, she knew everyone.
Anyone wishing to apply should submit a CV by Friday.
He was the only candidate to pass all three interviews.
Confronted with falling sales, the directors changed strategy.
Not knowing the dress code, I turned up in jeans.

C2-4-2.name: Same verb, new meaning
C2-4-2.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con el verbo en mayúsculas en la forma correcta (-ing o to + infinitivo) para que signifique lo mismo.
items: Taking the post in Lima would involve moving my whole family. (MEAN) → Taking the post in Lima ______ my whole family.
After finishing her degree, she later became a celebrated architect. (WENT) → After finishing her degree, she ______ a celebrated architect.
I'm sorry I didn't accept that offer. (REGRET) → I ______ that offer.
We are sorry to tell you that your application has been unsuccessful. (REGRET) → We ______ your application has been unsuccessful.
The website should be updated. (NEEDS) → The website ______.
As an experiment, I switched the laptop off and on again. (TRIED) → I ______ the laptop off and on again.
answers: Taking the post in Lima would mean moving my whole family.
After finishing her degree, she went on to become a celebrated architect.
I regret not accepting that offer.
We regret to inform you that your application has been unsuccessful.
The website needs updating.
I tried switching the laptop off and on again.

C2-5-0.name: Report it impersonally
C2-5-0.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: People believe that the virus originated in bats. (BELIEVED) → The virus ______ in bats.
Experts think the company is testing a new chip. (THOUGHT) → The company ______ a new chip.
They say there are over a million users. (SAID) → There ______ over a million users.
It is alleged that the records were falsified. (ALLEGED) → The records ______ falsified.
Nobody likes it when people ignore them. (BEING) → Nobody likes ______.
It is reported that the CEO has resigned. (REPORTED) → The CEO ______.
answers: The virus is believed to have originated in bats.
The company is thought to be testing a new chip.
There are said to be over a million users.
The records are alleged to have been falsified.
Nobody likes being ignored.
The CEO is reported to have resigned.

C2-5-1.name: Who does it?
C2-5-1.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas usando una estructura causativa (transformación tipo CPE).
items: A technician is going to install the new software for us. (HAVING) → We ______ installed.
Someone hacked my email account last week. (HAD) → I ______ last week.
I'll ask my secretary to book your flight. (HAVE) → I'll ______ your flight.
We finally persuaded the landlord to repair the roof. (GOT) → We finally ______ the roof.
A private lab sequenced our genome. (HAD) → We ______ by a private lab.
I refuse to tolerate you lying to your patients. (HAVE) → I won't ______ to your patients.
answers: We are having the new software installed.
I had my email account hacked last week.
I'll have my secretary book your flight.
We finally got the landlord to repair the roof.
We had our genome sequenced by a private lab.
I won't have you lying to your patients.

C2-5-2.name: Hedge it
C2-5-2.prompt: Reescribe cada afirmación de forma más prudente y académica usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: Social media causes loneliness. (MAY) → Social media ______ loneliness.
Older users are more cautious online. (TEND) → Older users ______ online.
The treatment is effective. (APPEAR) → It ______ effective.
This proves that the policy failed. (SUGGESTS) → This ______ failed.
Surveillance is a threat to democracy. (ARGUED) → It ______ a threat to democracy.
The model explains the data completely. (EXTENT) → The model explains the data ______.
answers: Social media may contribute to loneliness.
Older users tend to be more cautious online.
It would appear that the treatment is effective.
This suggests that the policy may have failed.
It could be argued that surveillance is a threat to democracy.
The model explains the data to some extent.

C2-6-0.name: Cross the timelines
C2-6-0.prompt: Completa cada frase con un condicional mixto o implícito, usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: We didn't plant trees ten years ago, so the town has no shade now. (WOULD) → If we had planted trees ten years ago, the town ______ now.
She isn't a patient person, so she didn't wait for the results. (HAVE) → If she were more patient, she ______ for the results.
They ignored the warnings, which is why the species is extinct today. (IF) → ______ the warnings, the species wouldn't be extinct today.
I don't speak Portuguese, so I couldn't follow the debate on Amazon policy. (FOLLOWED) → If I spoke Portuguese, I ______ the debate.
If it hadn't been for the volunteers, the beach clean-up would have failed. (WITHOUT) → ______, the beach clean-up would have failed.
I would have joined the protest; however, I was ill. (BUT) → I would have joined ______.
answers: If we had planted trees ten years ago, the town would have shade now.
If she were more patient, she would have waited for the results.
If they hadn't ignored the warnings, the species wouldn't be extinct today.
If I spoke Portuguese, I could have followed the debate.
Without the volunteers, the beach clean-up would have failed.
I would have joined the protest, but I was ill.

C2-6-1.name: Invert the condition
C2-6-1.prompt: Reescribe cada frase sin if, empezando con las palabras dadas (transformación tipo CPE).
items: If you require further information, please contact our office. → Should ______
If the ice sheet were to collapse, sea levels would rise dramatically. → Were ______
If we had known the area was protected, we wouldn't have camped there. → Had ______
If it weren't for international aid, the reserve would close. → Were ______
If the volunteers hadn't acted quickly, the turtles would have died. → Had ______
Without the early warning system, hundreds would have died. → Had it not ______
answers: Should you require further information, please contact our office.
Were the ice sheet to collapse, sea levels would rise dramatically.
Had we known the area was protected, we wouldn't have camped there.
Were it not for international aid, the reserve would close.
Had the volunteers not acted quickly, the turtles would have died.
Had it not been for the early warning system, hundreds would have died.

C2-6-2.name: Without if
C2-6-2.prompt: Reescribe cada frase con la palabra en mayúsculas, sin usar if.
items: If it hadn't been for the rangers, the rhinos would have been poached. (BUT) → ______, the rhinos would have been poached.
You can fish here, but only if you return what you catch. (PROVIDED) → You can fish here ______ what you catch.
Imagine the Amazon reached a tipping point. What would happen? (SUPPOSING) → ______, what would happen?
We must cut emissions now. If we don't, temperatures will soar. (OTHERWISE) → We must cut emissions now; ______.
The reef will die if water temperatures don't fall. (UNLESS) → The reef will die ______.
They agreed to sell the land if it was kept as a nature reserve. (CONDITION) → They agreed to sell the land ______ as a nature reserve.
answers: But for the rangers, the rhinos would have been poached.
You can fish here provided (that) you return what you catch.
Supposing the Amazon reached a tipping point, what would happen?
We must cut emissions now; otherwise, temperatures will soar.
The reef will die unless water temperatures fall.
They agreed to sell the land on condition that it was kept as a nature reserve.

C2-7-0.name: Say it once
C2-7-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase evitando la repetición con so, not, one, do so, to o un auxiliar, usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: Will the director's new film be as good as her last film? (ONE) → Will the director's new film be as good as her ______?
'Is the concert sold out?' 'I'm afraid that it is sold out.' (SO) → 'I'm ______.'
'Will the critics hate it?' 'I hope they won't hate it.' (NOT) → 'I ______.'
The board was asked to reconsider its decision, but it declined to reconsider its decision. (DO) → …but it declined ______.
I haven't seen the exhibition yet, but I'm going to see it. (TO) → I haven't seen the exhibition yet, but I'm going ______.
Is the manuscript authentic? If it is authentic, it's priceless. (SO) → Is the manuscript authentic? ______, it's priceless.
answers: Will the director's new film be as good as her last one?
I'm afraid so.
I hope not.
The board was asked to reconsider its decision, but it declined to do so.
I haven't seen the exhibition yet, but I'm going to.
Is the manuscript authentic? If so, it's priceless.

C2-7-1.name: Pick the right intensifier
C2-7-1.prompt: Corrige o reescribe cada frase con el intensificador o atenuador adecuado; usa la palabra en mayúsculas cuando aparezca.
items: The ending was very magnificent. (Corrige el intensificador.)
I was absolutely tired after the four-hour opera. (Corrige el intensificador.)
Her debut novel received wide acclaim. (HIGHLY) → Her debut novel was ______.
The audience was disappointed, and they felt it bitterly. (BITTERLY) → The audience was ______.
The plot was a little predictable, I'm afraid. (SOMEWHAT) → The plot was ______, I'm afraid.
Her performance was completely extraordinary. (QUITE) → Her performance was ______.
answers: The ending was absolutely magnificent.
I was extremely tired after the four-hour opera.
Her debut novel was highly acclaimed.
The audience was bitterly disappointed.
The plot was somewhat predictable, I'm afraid.
Her performance was quite extraordinary.

C2-7-2.name: Order and compound
C2-7-2.prompt: Ordena los adjetivos o crea un adjetivo compuesto para completar cada frase.
items: a / Italian / beautiful / old / leather / handbag (Ordena.)
The documentary lasts two hours. → It's a ______ documentary.
The novel provokes a great deal of thought. → It's a highly ______ novel.
The production has won several awards. → It's an ______ production.
a / wooden / Japanese / small / tea / box / lovely (Ordena.)
The film was shot beautifully. → It's a ______ film.
answers: a beautiful old Italian leather handbag
It's a two-hour documentary.
It's a highly thought-provoking novel.
It's an award-winning production.
a lovely small Japanese wooden tea box
It's a beautifully shot film.

C2-8-0.name: Make it formal
C2-8-0.prompt: Reescribe cada frase en registro formal con un subjuntivo o una fórmula fija, usando la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: The committee wants him to step down immediately. (DEMANDS) → The committee ______ immediately.
Every citizen must have access to legal aid. (ESSENTIAL) → It is ______ access to legal aid.
The judge recommended not publishing the witnesses' names. (BE) → The judge recommended that the witnesses' names ______.
Whatever happens, we will defend this right. (COME) → ______, we will defend this right.
That may be true, but the law is still unjust. (BE) → ______, the law is still unjust.
I don't want to criticise the judge, but the ruling is odd. (FAR) → ______ the judge, but the ruling is odd.
answers: The committee demands that he step down immediately.
It is essential that every citizen have access to legal aid.
The judge recommended that the witnesses' names not be published.
Come what may, we will defend this right.
Be that as it may, the law is still unjust.
Far be it from me to criticise the judge, but the ruling is odd.

C2-8-1.name: Wishes and regrets
C2-8-1.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: I regret not reading the contract before signing. (WISH) → I ______ before signing.
It's a pity I'm not old enough to vote. (ONLY) → If ______ to vote.
The government should have reformed the police long ago. (HIGH) → It's ______ the police.
Please don't mention my name in the report. (RATHER) → I'd ______ my name in the report.
He behaves like the owner of the place, but he isn't. (AS) → He behaves ______ the place.
It annoys me that my neighbour keeps playing loud music. (WOULD) → I wish ______ loud music.
answers: I wish I had read the contract before signing.
If only I were old enough to vote.
It's high time the government reformed the police.
I'd rather you didn't mention my name in the report.
He behaves as if he owned the place.
I wish my neighbour would stop playing loud music.

C2-8-2.name: Concede the point
C2-8-2.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: Although the evidence was overwhelming, the jury acquitted him. (DESPITE) → ______, the jury acquitted him.
I admire her a lot, but I can't support her campaign. (MUCH) → ______, I can't support her campaign.
The reform was a success, though only a partial one. (ALBEIT) → The reform was a success, ______.
It doesn't matter how popular the policy is; it's unconstitutional. (HOWEVER) → ______, it's unconstitutional.
In spite of the ban, thousands gathered in the square. (NOTWITHSTANDING) → ______, thousands gathered in the square.
Although it may seem ironic, the protest strengthened the government. (IRONIC) → ______, the protest strengthened the government.
answers: Despite the overwhelming evidence, the jury acquitted him.
Much as I admire her, I can't support her campaign.
The reform was a success, albeit a partial one.
However popular the policy may be, it's unconstitutional.
Notwithstanding the ban, thousands gathered in the square.
Ironic as it may seem, the protest strengthened the government.

C2-9-0.name: The future that was
C2-9-0.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: I intended to take up yoga, but I never did. (GOING) → I ______ yoga, but I never did.
The final was scheduled for Saturday, but it was cancelled. (HAVE) → The final ______ on Saturday.
She was just going to dive when the whistle blew. (ABOUT) → She ______ when the whistle blew.
He didn't know it then, but that injury ended his career. (WAS) → That injury ______ his career.
The patient was very close to giving up when the new treatment arrived. (POINT) → The patient ______ when the new treatment arrived.
The flight was scheduled to land at six. (DUE) → The flight ______ at six.
answers: I was going to take up yoga, but I never did.
The final was to have been played on Saturday.
She was about to dive when the whistle blew.
That injury was to end his career.
The patient was on the point of giving up when the new treatment arrived.
The flight was due to land at six.

C2-9-1.name: Link it
C2-9-1.prompt: Une o reescribe las ideas con el marcador del discurso en mayúsculas.
items: The study was small. However, its findings are striking. (ADMITTEDLY) → ______, the study was small; even so, its findings are striking.
Smokers had a higher risk. Non-smokers had a lower one. (CONVERSELY) → Smokers had a higher risk; ______.
Both diet and sleep matter, but sleep is often ignored. (LATTER) → Both diet and sleep matter, but ______.
The trial lacked funding, and this explains its small size. (HENCE) → The trial lacked funding; ______.
Extreme sports are dangerous. But I must say, accidents are rarer than you'd think. (MIND) → Extreme sports are dangerous. ______.
Running is cheap. It's also good for mental health. (WHAT) → Running is cheap. ______.
answers: Admittedly, the study was small; even so, its findings are striking.
Smokers had a higher risk; conversely, non-smokers had a lower one.
Both diet and sleep matter, but the latter is often ignored.
The trial lacked funding; hence its small size.
Extreme sports are dangerous. Mind you, accidents are rarer than you'd think.
Running is cheap. What is more, it's good for mental health.

C2-9-2.name: Formalise it
C2-9-2.prompt: Reescribe cada frase en registro formal con el verbo en mayúsculas y su preposición correcta.
items: Researchers looked into the effects of night shifts. (INVESTIGATED) → Researchers ______ night shifts.
The conference has been put off until March. (POSTPONED) → The conference ______.
Patients should stay away from alcohol during the trial. (REFRAIN) → Patients should ______ during the trial.
Stress can lead to heart disease. (RESULT) → Heart disease can ______ stress.
The committee is made up of seven doctors. (COMPRISES) → The committee ______.
All staff must follow the safety rules. (COMPLY) → All staff must ______.
answers: Researchers investigated the effects of night shifts.
The conference has been postponed until March.
Patients should refrain from drinking alcohol during the trial.
Heart disease can result from stress.
The committee comprises seven doctors.
All staff must comply with the safety rules.

C2-10-0.name: Futures with precision
C2-10-0.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: It has been officially announced that the president will visit the ruins on Friday. (IS) → The president ______ on Friday.
According to the schedule, the bridge will open in May. (DUE) → The bridge ______ in May.
The old language will disappear very soon. (VERGE) → The old language ______.
My grandparents started running the bakery forty years ago next year. (HAVE) → By next year, my grandparents ______ for forty years.
Visitors must not touch the exhibits. (ARE) → Visitors ______ the exhibits.
The archive will almost certainly be digitised by 2030. (SET) → The archive ______ by 2030.
answers: The president is to visit the ruins on Friday.
The bridge is due to open in May.
The old language is on the verge of disappearing.
By next year, my grandparents will have been running the bakery for forty years.
Visitors are not to touch the exhibits.
The archive is set to be digitised by 2030.

C2-10-1.name: Compare with nuance
C2-10-1.prompt: Completa la segunda frase con la palabra en mayúsculas para que signifique lo mismo (transformación tipo CPE).
items: The new library isn't nearly as beautiful as the old one. (NOWHERE) → The new library ______ the old one.
As cities grow bigger, they become more anonymous. (THE) → ______ cities grow, ______ they become.
Folk music is just as important as classical music. (BIT) → Folk music ______ classical music.
It isn't really nostalgia; it's more a sense of loss. (SO) → It's ______ a sense of loss.
Prices are slightly higher than last year. (MARGINALLY) → Prices ______ last year.
No building in the town is nearly as old as this one. (FAR) → This is ______ in the town.
answers: The new library is nowhere near as beautiful as the old one.
The bigger cities grow, the more anonymous they become.
Folk music is every bit as important as classical music.
It's not so much nostalgia as a sense of loss.
Prices are marginally higher than last year.
This is by far the oldest building in the town.

C2-10-2.name: Complete the expression
C2-10-2.prompt: Completa el proverbio o la expresión fija; en las tres últimas, usa la palabra en mayúsculas.
items: We lost the funding, but now we're free to choose our own projects. Well, every cloud ______.
Don't celebrate yet; the contract isn't signed. Don't count ______.
He still writes all his letters by hand. Old habits ______.
In general, the restoration has been a success. (LARGE) → ______, the restoration has been a success.
Uncertainty is an inherent part of any reform. (PARCEL) → Uncertainty is ______ any reform.
The museum will need a new roof eventually. (LATER) → ______, the museum will need a new roof.
answers: Well, every cloud has a silver lining.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
Old habits die hard.
By and large, the restoration has been a success.
Uncertainty is part and parcel of any reform.
Sooner or later, the museum will need a new roof.
